revision_summary: One quote timestamp needs correction and two schema-reference/classification issues should be tightened on rerun: (1) In script_coverage's address_homeowner entry, the customer_quote 'The address is 4819 Sedonia Avenue, Apartment C.' is correctly quoted but mistimed — move it from ts 00:24 to approximately 01:16-01:22 (00:24 is the rep's question, not the customer's answer). (2) Re-tag cherry_pick_moments[2] ('So it also is a business', 01:30) — remove or soften the implication that this could represent an unexplored qualifying opportunity; dq_rules.not_homeowner disqualifies on the apartment/non-owner status itself, and there's no schema basis for treating co-located business use as a workaround. Reclassify as 'other' rather than 'knowledge_gap' if kept. (3) Re-tag cherry_pick_moments[4] ('Could you call them for me?', 02:11) — the schema_reference to coaching_philosophy.empathy_on_vulnerability_disclosure is a mismatch; that section is scoped to health/financial/family/scam disclosures, not a request to phone a competitor. Reclassify as 'other' or flag as a schema gap instead. (4) Incorporate the omitted line at 01:34 ('I'm sorry to tell you') into the priority-1 coaching_focus — the rep did offer a softening phrase before the flat 'I have no idea,' which should soften the severity of that coaching note from 'bare-minimum non-answer with no softening' to a narrower gap (softened tone but no substantive referral/direction offered).
